title: Year 5 · Maths Wednesdays
status: First interactive investigation for all 15 blocks; full small-step curriculum remains in development
sources: England Year 5 mathematics programme of study

units.title: Addition & subtraction
goals: Add and subtract whole numbers with more than four digits.
Explain exchanges and check with the inverse operation.
units.remaining: Multi-step word problems, estimation and choosing mental or written methods.

units.title: Multiplication & division A
goals: Find factor pairs and distinguish primes from composite numbers.
Connect factors to arrays and square numbers.
units.remaining: Common factors, common multiples, prime factors and multiplying/dividing by powers of ten.

units.title: Fractions A
goals: Add and subtract fractions with related denominators.
Connect equivalent fractions, mixed numbers and improper fractions.
units.remaining: Ordering mixed numbers, more varied equivalent fractions and contextual problems.

units.title: Multiplication & division B
goals: Use partitioning to explain multiplication by a two-digit number.
Connect multiplication and division as inverse operations.
units.remaining: Compact long multiplication, short division and interpreting remainders in context.

units.title: Fractions B
goals: Multiply proper fractions and mixed numbers by whole numbers.
Explain results greater than one using diagrams.
units.remaining: Fractions of quantities, finding the whole and multi-step fraction problems.

units.title: Decimals & percentages
goals: Recognise hundredths as decimals and percentages.
Use familiar fraction–decimal–percentage equivalents.
units.remaining: Thousandths, comparing decimals and percentages of quantities.

units.title: Perimeter & area
goals: Distinguish area from perimeter.
Find areas of rectangles and composite rectilinear shapes.
units.remaining: Missing side lengths, real units and estimating irregular areas.

units.title: Statistics
goals: Read, interpret and construct data displays.
Answer comparison, sum and difference questions.
units.remaining: Line graphs, timetables and two-way tables.

units.title: Shape
goals: Estimate, measure and draw angles in degrees.
Reason about angles on a straight line and around a point.
units.remaining: Polygon properties, regular and irregular polygons and identifying 3D shapes from 2D representations.

units.title: Position & direction
goals: Describe translations using coordinates.
Reflect shapes in horizontal and vertical lines.
units.remaining: Reasoning about several transformations and finding unknown vertices.

units.title: Decimals
goals: Multiply and divide whole numbers and decimals by 10, 100 and 1,000.
Track each digit’s changing value.
units.remaining: Decimal addition/subtraction, rounding, ordering and sequences.

units.title: Negative numbers
goals: Interpret negative numbers in context.
Count forwards and backwards through zero.
units.remaining: Comparing negative numbers in other contexts and finding temperature differences.

units.title: Converting units
goals: Convert between common metric units.
Connect conversions to multiplying and dividing by powers of ten.
units.remaining: Approximate imperial equivalents, time conversions and contextual problems.

units.title: Volume
goals: Understand volume by counting unit cubes.
Connect equal layers and multiplication.
units.remaining: Estimating volume and capacity and reasoning about practical measures.

assessment: Browser-local unit records; no secure pupil accounts or mastery claims
